fullPassage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.

❌ ③ create → creates: 'current technology ___ notorious hazards'에서 주어 technology는 단수이므로 현재형 creates가 되어야 해요. ← 정답

✅ ④ can: 'can vary(다를 수 있다)'에서 조동사 can이 맞아요.
det.tip: 단수 주어 technology + 현재형 -s: technology creates.

det.korean: 밑줄 친 표현이 가리키는 의미를 추론하는 문항이에요.
det.analysis:
① we can no longer tell how much energy (calories) a food really contains(우리가 음식에 실제로 얼마나 많은 열량이 들어 있는지 더 이상 알 수 없다): 뒤에 '지방 함량이 겉모습에 드러나지 않는다, 열량이 상당히 다르다'가 이어지므로 정답이에요. ← 정답

② modern machines often break down while processing food(현대 기계가 식품 가공 중 자주 고장 난다): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.

③ eating too fast seriously harms our digestion(너무 빨리 먹으면 소화에 큰 해가 된다): 본문과 무관해요.

④ food factories pollute the environment with energy waste(식품 공장이 에너지 폐기물로 환경을 오염시킨다): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.
det.tip: energy perception = 음식의 열량을 감지하는 능력. 그 '위험'은 열량을 알 수 없게 된 것이에요.

ch: we can no longer tell how much energy (calories) a food really contains
modern machines often break down while processing food
eating too fast seriously harms our digestion
food factories pollute the environment with energy waste

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that <u>they</u> will get a nutritionally adequate diet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>they</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 대상을 찾는 문항이에요.
det.analysis:
본문 'people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet'에서 they는 바로 앞의 people(사람들)을 가리켜요.

② 가공식품은 식단을 '얻는' 주체가 아니에요.
③ 식품 회사는 본문의 주어가 아니에요.
④ 영양소는 식단을 얻는 주체가 아니에요.
det.tip: they will get a diet에서 '식단을 얻는' 주체 = people.

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, __________, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt(지방·설탕·소금을 넣어 맛있게 만든) — 가공식품의 특징.
det.analysis:
❌ ① grown naturally without any chemicals(화학물질 없이 자연적으로 재배된): 가공식품 설명과 반대예요.

✅ ② made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt: 'the array of such processed food products, ___, is vast'에서 가공식품이 '지방·설탕·소금을 넣어 맛있게 만들어진다'는 설명이에요. ← 정답

❌ ③ sold only in small local markets(작은 지역 시장에서만 팔리는): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.

❌ ④ designed to spoil very quickly(아주 빨리 상하도록 만들어진): 본문과 무관해요.
det.tip: 가공식품은 fat·sugar·salt를 더해 'made tasty(맛있게)' 만들어져요.

ch: made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt
sold only in small local markets

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current __________. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'기술은 에너지 인식에 악명 높은 위험을 초래한다.'

[조건]
(1) creates, energy, for, hazards, notorious, perception, technology 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 기술이 에너지 인식에 위험을 초래한다는 문장.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- technology(주어): 기술은
- creates(동사): 초래한다
- notorious hazards(목적어): 악명 높은 위험을
- for energy perception(전치사구): 에너지 인식에 대해
- 단수 주어 technology에 맞춰 동사에 -s를 붙여 creates로 써요.
det.tip: 단수 주어 + creates. '~에 대한'은 전치사 for로 연결하세요.

questions.wa: technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception
accept: technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more __________ (color) at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

... to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more __________ (color) at will.

det.korean: color를 형용사로 변형.
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'make them ... more ___'에서 비교급 more 뒤에는 형용사가 와야 해요. 명사 color에 -ful을 붙여 형용사 colorful(색이 화려한)로 바꿔 'more colorful(더 화려한)'을 완성해요.
det.tip: 명사 + -ful → 형용사: color → colorful(화려한).

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. __________ from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'많은 가공식품의 지방 함량은 분명하게 드러나지 않는다.'

[조건]
(1) clearly, content, evident, fat, foods, is, many, not, of, processed, The 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 많은 가공식품의 지방 함량은 분명히 드러나지 않는다는 문장.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- The fat content of many processed foods(주어구): 많은 가공식품의 지방 함량은
- is not clearly evident(동사+부정+보어): 분명하게 드러나지 않는다
- 주어의 핵심은 단수 content이므로 동사는 is를 쓰고, not이 clearly evident를 부정해요.
det.tip: 주어 핵심 content(단수) → is. not이 clearly evident 전체를 부정해요.

questions.wa: The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident
accept: The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. __________. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하시오. (12단어, 영어로)

'비슷한 맛의 다양한 음식의 열량은 상당히 다를 수 있다.'

[a / can / considerably / content / energy / foods / of / of / similar-tasting / The / variety / vary]

det.korean: 비슷한 맛의 다양한 음식의 열량은 상당히 다를 수 있다는 문장.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods(주어구): 비슷한 맛의 다양한 음식의 열량은
- can vary considerably(조동사+동사+부사): 상당히 다를 수 있다
- 'a variety of + 명사(다양한 ~)' 구조가 주어를 길게 꾸며요.
det.tip: a variety of(다양한) + 명사로 주어를 만들고, 끝에 can vary considerably를 배열하세요.

questions.wa: The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably
accept: The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to __________ tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'그것들을 더 달거나 더 짜거나 더 진하게 만들다'

[조건]
(1) make, or, richer, saltier, sweeter, them 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 그것들을 더 달거나 짜거나 진하게 만든다는 표현.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- make them(동사+목적어): 그것들을 ~하게 만들다
- sweeter or saltier or richer(목적격 보어): 더 달거나 더 짜거나 더 진한
- 'make + 목적어 + 형용사(비교급)' 구조이고, 세 형용사를 or로 병렬 연결해요.
det.tip: make them + 비교급 형용사(sweeter/saltier/richer)를 or로 나열하세요.

questions.wa: make them sweeter or saltier or richer
accept: make them sweeter or saltier or richer
